name: Langry Testing Anvil (GZ Series)
short_description: High-precision tool steel test anvil hardened to HRC 60 ± 2 for daily calibration verification of concrete test hammers per IS 13311-2 and ASTM C805.
description: The **Langry GZ Series Calibration Test Anvil** is an indispensable reference instrument for any lab operating concrete test hammers. Machined from premium high-carbon tool steel and hardened to HRC 60 ± 2, it guarantees accurate daily calibration checks before and after structural inspections.

key_features.feature: Manufactured from high-carbon alloy tool steel
Core surface hardness strictly controlled to HRC 60 ± 2
Certified nominal calibration value of 80 ± 2 for Type N hammers
Standard 16 kg heavy benchtop weight ensures stability during test impacts
Mandatory requirement under IS 13311-2, ASTM C805, and EN 12504-2

seo_title: Langry Calibration Test Anvil (HRC 60±2) | Accurion Technologies
seo_description: Certified Langry steel calibration test anvil (HRC 60 ± 2, 16 kg) for rebound hammer daily verification per IS 13311-2 & ASTM C805.
